CHOOSE BY OUTPUT

what you need to make.

Choose an output, then follow a path built from real work.

Each path has five stages. Follow them in order, or jump to the example you need now.

7 PATHS
Choose a path.

Compare when to start, what you will make, and how long it may take.

Explorer
Use AI to understand yourself
START WHEN
You need to understand how you think before choosing what to build.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Personal cognitive mirror and bridge to creation
4–8 weeks
→
Builder
Build production apps with AI
START WHEN
You need to turn an AI-assisted prototype into a production application.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Deployed production application
8–12 weeks
→
Architect
Design systems someone else can build
START WHEN
You need documentation another person can build from without asking you to reconstruct the system.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Complete system architecture using arc42, a standard template for documenting software architecture
8–12 weeks
→
Strategist
Turn evidence into a decision
START WHEN
You need scattered evidence to become a decision-ready recommendation.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Executive-ready strategic brief
6–10 weeks
→
Author
Build a reference, not a pile of chapters
START WHEN
You need a durable multi-chapter reference rather than another standalone article.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Multi-volume playbook of 20,000+ words
12–20 weeks
→
Voice
Define a voice that survives scale
START WHEN
You need consistent voice based on actual writing rather than a list of adjectives.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Complete voice system with validation
6–10 weeks
→
Enterprise
Scale useful AI practice across a team
START WHEN
You need one useful local AI pattern to work safely across a team.
WHAT YOU’LL MAKE
Reusable team skill with quality gates
10–16 weeks
→
